question.prompt: A person commutes 10 km each day. A bus emits 0.05 kg per kilometer, while a private car emits 0.2 kg per kilometer. By switching to the bus, how many kg of emissions are saved each day?

solutions.explanation: The emissions saved per kilometer are \(0.2-0.05=0.15\) kg. Over 10 km, the total emissions saved are \(10\times0.15=1.5\) kg.
solutions.title: Savings per kilometer
